items.title: HB 24-108 — FY 2027 budget
items.plain: The Government’s budget for October 2026 to September 2027. A House amendment reserves half of certain special accounts for retirees’ benefits, including health insurance.
items.note: passed by the House, Sept 2026 · now in the Senate

items.title: Public Law 24-20 — revised FY 2026 budget
items.plain: The $138.9 million revised budget that funded retiree health insurance for 2026 and allowed the Aetna contract to be renewed.

items.title: HB 24-75 — retiree health & life insurance
items.plain: Proposed $2.8 million for retiree group health and life insurance, leaving a $4.4 million gap.
items.note: passed by the House on 5 Dec 2025 · later status to confirm
